The lobby and room cards say how many are on a call

acs.text: WHEN LiveKit posts to `POST /api/v1/internal/livekit/webhook` THE SYSTEM SHALL verify the signature with the LiveKit API key and secret; WHEN it is missing or invalid it SHALL answer 401 and change nothing
WHEN the same webhook event (same event id) arrives twice THE SYSTEM SHALL apply it once, recorded in `webhook_receipts`
scenarios: AC-002 a repeated event applies once

acs.text: WHEN a `participant_joined`, `participant_left` or `room_finished` event for `room_<roomId>` is applied THE SYSTEM SHALL store that room's call status `{ live, participants, startedAt }` from the event's room information, never with fewer than 0 participants, and with `live: false` after `room_finished`; events for rooms that do not exist SHALL be ignored
scenarios: AC-003 joins, leaves and the end of a call

acs.text: WHEN a member reads a room's status, or the feed lists a room, while the room's call is live THE SYSTEM SHALL include `call: { live: true, participants }`, and the lobby and room cards SHALL show "N on a call"; WHEN no call is live (or LiveKit is not configured) the field SHALL be absent, nothing SHALL show, and nothing errors
scenarios: AC-004 the lobby and cards show the call

acs.text: WHEN the user-deleted webhook for user U is handled THE SYSTEM SHALL remove identity `u:U` from every room where the call status is live, through LiveKit's server API; a failed removal SHALL be retried once and logged, and SHALL not stop the rest of the deletion
scenarios: AC-005 a deleted account leaves every call

acs.text: WHEN the deletion test walks the schema after deleting a user THE SYSTEM SHALL find zero rows for that user, including in any table this spec adds
scenarios: AC-006 nothing of the user remains
